**Finding: Deviation (MINCOMMIT)**

Section 5(a) contains a take-or-pay floor — Client must pay "not less than $____ per month" for Hosting Services and Support Services irrespective of what it actually requests, with the amounts left blank. Section 6 compounds this by carving the minimum monthly fees out of Client's right to supporting documentation and to contest charges (and mis-cites "Section 4"). Because Section 13 renews the term automatically for successive one-year periods, the floor recurs indefinitely; the at-will exit in Section 14 (effective the last day of the month following notice) mitigates the exposure but does not eliminate the commitment, and there is no true-up mechanism.

Redline validated (ok:true) and submitted at the preferred level: delete the minimum-fee parenthetical in Section 5(a) and the two orphaned carve-outs in Section 6, with the 12-month/30-day-reducible/trued-up floor offered as fallback in the comment.
